entries.candidate: Nauen Bebauungsplan „Rechenzentrum 2“ (AM:PM Grund Alpha GmbH; Sondergebiet „Rechenzentrum und rechenzentrumsnahe Technologien“, about 11 ha, Flur 17 Flurstücke 37-41, 255, 257, 259, 261 and 263, Gemarkung Nauen) — extension of the maincubes mainHub Nauen / BER02 site
entries.reason: The Amtsblatt für die Stadt Nauen Nr. 5/2026 (published 26 October 2026, pp. 15-17) gives notice of the shortened renewed publication (27.10.-10.11.2026) of the amended draft B-Plan „Rechenzentrum 2“: a data-centre campus of several modules, an entrance building and UPS facilities on about 11 ha east of the B-Plan „Rechenzentrum“; the same issue reports the council decision of 7 October 2026 to display the FNP amendment „Südliche Erweiterung GE Ost“ covering both plans. The draft Begründung (DiPlanung, March 2026) says the plan was prompted by the expected future operator maincubes, which is already realising the project in the adjoining B-Plan „Rechenzentrum“, and that the area is to be developed as an extension of that site; maincubes is also named for waste-heat supply. By the Atlas rule this is a new project on the existing site curated:maincubes-mainhub-nauen-campus, which must reuse that site's locator exactly. The existing BER02 locator is a reviewed_site_locator (first-party campus reference point), and the builder accepts additions to an existing site only with a campus_locator, so the project cannot be expressed. A separate new site would duplicate the campus. Resolves the identity part of the de-north-east-p1 Nauen hold: the developer (AM:PM Grund Alpha GmbH) and parcels are now known. Sources captured locally: nauen-amtsblatt-2026-05.pdf, diplan-bb-nauen-rz2-*.html, nauen-rz2-june-begruendung.pdf.
entries.reopen_condition: The update format accepts a new project on a site whose only locator is a reviewed_site_locator, or the maincubes Nauen site gains a campus_locator; then add „Rechenzentrum 2“ as announced (Amtsblatt Nauen 5/2026, 26 October 2026) reusing it, with the Flur 17 parcel union as context.
